key.name: update-delay
key.description: Delay (in ms) between screen updates. Decreasing this value may make snow fall more smoothly, but will also increase CPU usage. (10 - 200)

key.name: screen-depth
key.description: How deep into the screen snowflakes can be drawn before being removed (0 - 2000)

key.name: screen-boxing
key.description: How far from the screen snowflakes can be drawn before being removed (0 - 2000)

key.name: over-windows
key.description: Elements drawn above windows

key.name: element-type
key.description: Element Movement Type

key.name: element-iter
key.description: Settings for one particular element configuration. Separate element definitions have different iters. This is a workaround to have multiple-textures per element until we can get cascading lists

key.name: element-image
key.description: Image file for this Element

key.name: element-cap
key.description: Total number of allowed element

key.name: element-size
key.description: Size of these elements

key.name: element-speed
key.description: Speed of these elements

key.name: element-rotate
key.description: Allow rotation of this element

key.name: title-font-color
key.description: Font color for the window title

key.name: title-font-size
key.description: Font size for the window title (6 - 96)

key.name: title-bold-font
key.description: Use a bold font

key.name: title-back-color
key.description: Background color for the window title

key.name: title-display-time
key.description: How long to display the title (in ms) (50 - 5000)

key.name: title-on-toggle
key.description: Show the element type when toggling the currently selected element
